scope: Checkpoint C: only Gupta2020 and Wigerblad2022 metadata. No expression matrix, H5, atlas, sequencing reads, target outcomes or new classifier.

sources.state_context: Published neutrophil subset labels, Results Fig3/SI TableS4; no actual barcode assignments recovered

sources.role: provenance and sole fallback; Gupta retained-cell/state export unresolved
sources.state_context: Published purified-neutrophil states, Results Fig2E-F; not a label transfer to other preparations

selection_rule: Gupta first by source, unit and assay completeness; Wigerblad only provenance/fallback, never selected by target outcomes. No pooling.
unknowns: Blank retained cells/state assignment/zero denominator are unknown, not zero. Title tokens are unverified donor clues; distinct accession IDs do not establish participant independence.

proposed_description.status: Conditional Gupta design held for author retained neutrophil/state barcode export, donor mapping and processing qualification; not execution authorization
proposed_description.unit: reported source donor; sample/GSM and sequencing runs nested. Exactly seven reported whole-blood samples; donor-to-GSM identity must qualify.
proposed_description.population: All author-retained neutrophils from RBC-depleted whole-blood leukocytes, including ARG1-zero and IL6R-zero cells; retain reported male/female sample metadata. No expression-positive selection.
proposed_description.states: author subset labels 0,1,2,3 only after actual barcode-label joins; no alignment to Wigerblad Nh labels or SCAHN states
proposed_description.endpoints: Within each sample/state, target nonzero-count fraction and mean log1p(10000 * raw target UMI / all-gene raw RNA UMI total); ARG1 and IL6R separate. Target count/total retained for audit.
proposed_description.denominator: Complete verified author-retained sample/state cell list, including target-zero cells. Empty verified state: composition zero, expression undefined; missing state/feature: unavailable.
proposed_description.comparisons: Descriptive paired within-donor state contrasts against author subset0 for each target/metric, contingent on both states present. Report every sample; no group contrast if support differs. Sex is reported annotation, not a new inferential sex effect.
proposed_description.weighting: Equal donor weights for complete support summaries; no cell weighting. Require all seven mapped donors for a combined state contrast; otherwise per-donor available results only. Threshold is reporting support, not power.
proposed_description.normalization: All RNA features in original raw count source, not the SCAHN 16711-gene subset; positive total RNA counts required by verified author retention. No imputation, integration, refiltering or classifier.
proposed_description.reduced_question: Not silently adopted. Removing state stratification would still require author-retained neutrophil identity and a complete target-zero denominator; review required.
proposed_description.limits: Source reuse, observational state selection, capture and preparation effects; no population tests, secretion, competence, suppressive function, lineage equivalence or IPF repair.
